mapper.select: SELECT pay08_tax_withholding_id AS tax_withholding_id, pay08_person_id AS person_id, COALESCE(emp01_kor_nm, '-') AS person_name, pay08_reg_date AS reg_date, pay08_note AS note, sys10_file_id AS file_id, sys10_file_nm AS file_name, sys10_file_ext AS file_ext FROM pay08_tax_withholding INNER JOIN sys10_file ON sys10_parent_id = pay08_tax_withholding_id LEFT OUTER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = pay08_person_id WHERE pay08_person_id = #{personId} ORDER BY sys10_file_nm DESC
